claims.claim_text:
Fill `source_document.git_blob` with the
output of `git rev-parse HEAD:<file>` (abbreviated to ≥ 7 chars).

values.quantity: minimum abbreviation length for source_document.git_blob, C4 extraction files

claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b054] The batch plan assigned lines 1-108 of this document against v1.0; the file is now 164 lines at v1.2 and no other batch covers the tail, so this extraction sweeps the whole current file (lines 1-164). This document is both this batch's instrument and one of its mine documents; it was read as instrument first, then extracted. Scope decisions logged per hard rule 5: the version strings (1.2, 1.1, 1.0, schema 1.1), session numbers (S123, Session-123), charter/schema section references, and the illustrative condition names on line 83 (`min6`, `t0.3`, `384` in `pv-diag-384`, which the rule itself declares names rather than claims) were all excluded as out of C4 scope. This value is a procedural rule parameter of the instrument, included with the doubt flagged per the batch brief. The 7-character minimum is encoded in the schema as a regular expression (`^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$` at $.properties.source_document.properties.git_blob.pattern in docs/manifest-schemas/c4-claims.schema.json), not as a scalar, so no mechanical read exists; anchor-unknown rather than manufacture a string-vs-number comparison.

claims.notes: Procedural rule parameter of the instrument (1-indexed line locators), included with the doubt flagged per the batch brief. The schema encodes the same convention as the minimum of the lines array items.
